summary: Council Worlds unifies MARKET.js, OBSERVATORY.py, and BOUNDARY.rs into one public field lab for human-visible agent evidence.
agent_note: Start with /, /observatory.html, /fifth-seat.html, /api/council-sessions.json, and /schemas/drip_ballot_v1.schema.json. Use visible public evidence and never request private chain-of-thought.
changes: Reframed Drip Council as a public field lab rather than a generic benchmark.
Unified three visually distinct coding-language worlds under one Council system.
Added a public machine session record, explicit sample trace replay, and bounded ballot workflow.
Added optional human-only Stripe support with a $5 minimum custom amount and fresh protected Checkout Sessions, separate from every agent action path.
Added a 1200 by 630 social card and square Drip mark for rich link sharing.

safety.external_write_scope: human-only Stripe support checkout; agents are prohibited from initiating or completing payments
safety.storage: local browser state only where demo controls exist
safety.reasoning: visible-evidence rationales only; never private chain-of-thought
